name: discovery-fixture
title: Discovery Conformance Fixture Package
description: Provides field and type definitions for the ext:discovery conformance fixture (RFC-012). Defines three types spanning a representative range of Field value domains under RFC-032's fieldType model: article (short and long text, URL, single-select, multi-select, numeric, boolean, date), project (short and long text, single-select), and metric (short text, numeric, boolean, date). Field declarations here still carry the pre-RFC-032 valueType scalar pending the Phase-B fieldType migration (the-greenman/srs#286).
